name: diff-fold
description: Shows one summary line per file instead of the diff under Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and file-changing Bash calls

smallDiffLines.title: Show small diffs
smallDiffLines.description: Diffs with this many changed lines or fewer are shown in full. 0 folds every diff.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Shown at the start of each summary line, so a hidden diff is easy to spot. Leave empty for none.
